text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the central plaza…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Shhh! I'm observing McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I feel like someone is watching me… Hm… It must be my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whew! That was a close one!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't let myself be spotted until I've figured out the secret to McQueen's strength.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No way! It's much more exciting to investigate it myself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wait! Where'd she go?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I only looked away for a second… Where could she have gone?
choice_data_list: Maybe she's belting out a song in the practice room.
I think she's worrying over something in the cafeteria.
I bet she's practicing at the training track!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I guess so. Let's head over there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There sure are a lot of practice rooms… I wonder where we should start.
Woo! Put your hands up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I hear a song… It's coming from this room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let me carry your dreams! ♪ Ahhh! Our victories! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow! Her voice is so clear, and yet so strong… How lovely. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Satono?! I mean, um… What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now I've done it… I thought I could go all out because the rooms are soundproofed…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. But thanks to that, I know your secret now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: S-s-s-secret?! What are you talking about?! A-all I was doing was singing for a little change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No. I can see right through you, McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You were psyching yourself up through song so you can up your performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? I mean, ahhh… Yeah, you got me… O…hohohoho…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So… Would you mind teaching me that rousing song you were singing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You thought it was rousing? Do you mean to say you… liked it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. There was such passion in the melody. Before I knew it, my heart was aflutter.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I would like to fully comprehend the emotion you poured into the song!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …There are two things I need to say first. Number one, you mustn't tell anyone about what happened today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And number two, this lesson will not be easy. Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Understood!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Okay, hold your head up high! Sing so the very heavens can hear you… One, two…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Put your hands up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond sings at the top of her lungs and masters the passionate song!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, I can just picture it. Well, shall we go check?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pancakes, fruit tarts… sweet potato cakes, and almond tofu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It all looks so good… But I can't go overboard! Think, McQueen… Think!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow… McQueen is so serious when it comes to desserts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …I think I understand the secret of her strength now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We should take even the smallest decisions in our daily lives seriously. All of these combined efforts add up to something very important!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gyah! S-Satono?! Were you watching me?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. You looked so serious… and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-well, that's… nice of you to say. But it's also a little embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: From now on, I'm going to take my dessert selection as seriously as you do!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's see here… Oh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Selection of Curious Morsels"… I'll go with that! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Squid ink cheesecake? Pudding sushi? What in the world is all this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um, Satono… Didn't you say you were going to choose carefully?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am! There are so many mysterious desserts… Don't you think there's a lot to be gained from trying them? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You're so inquisitive! You intend to just dive right in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then I shall join you. Let us explore these curious morsels together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Great! Let's explore new frontiers together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In that case… How about the mushroom Mont Blanc?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Um, Satono. Could we think just a little bit more carefully?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After extensive consideration, the two enjoy some desserts together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah yes, the classic secret training session. Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um… Why are you standing in the middle of the track?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This is a checkpoint. If you want to get past, you need to make me laugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You're being a nuisance. Hurry up and get out of the way.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Um… Was that supposed to be funny?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It wasn't a joke! Now, move before I make you move!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Out of my way!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What in the?! I couldn't budge her an inch!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And there she goes… What power. Terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um, what were you two just doing? It looked like you were sumo wrestling…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's right. It was an unthinkable final bout. I was powerless against her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Could McQueen's strength lie in her rock-solid lower body strength?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Golshi. Would you wrestle me too?! I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh… It's still too early for you. Go work on your one-liners and get back to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: One-liners?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't seem to improve my time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Maybe I spent too much energy dealing with Gold Ship earlier. Speaking of Gold Ship… I hope she doesn't cause me any more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Uh-oh. What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding ding!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Soleus muscle!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Soleus muscle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! Put your back into it! McQueen was way more serious when she did it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Got it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I did nothing of the sort!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Umm, how do I explain thi—oh, where did Golshi get off to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Over the course of her strange joke practice, Satono Diamond happens to build muscle strength!
